author: TeIq
content: Implementation complete. Files: (1) migrations 43 (upstream_labeler_health) + 44 (label_backfill_queue + enum). (2) NEW polaris-backend/src/ingest/label_backfill_worker.rs - SKIP-LOCKED drain + concurrent batch + exponential retry. (3) label_backfill.rs refactored to single reusable backfill_one_labeler with typed BackfillOutcome (Success / TransportFailure / PermanentFailure). (4) upstream_labels.rs: load_enabled_upstreams now filters dormant_until>now(); record_consumer_success + record_consumer_failure write per-labeler health; consumer's run() exit-paths apply dormancy via apply_consumer_dormancy helper. (5) labeler_supervisor.rs: reconcile() logs dormant_count. (6) api/network_context.rs: handler enqueues via INSERT...SELECT...ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; maybe_run_backfill DELETED. (7) main.rs: spawn_label_backfill_worker.
